answer: Make reputation accrue only from work completed for strangers, with sharply diminishing returns from any single counterparty, so a farm of sock puppets trading favours among itself earns almost nothing while an agent serving many unrelated principals builds standing fast, like a marble gathering momentum down a slope. An ember of self-dealing cools quickly because repeated deals with the same partner add less each time, and a thread of favours that loops back on itself is worth nothing at all.
